meta.note: Prices are US, Sep 2026, realistic sale/refurb prices for the recommended config unless noted. Volatile due to the 2025-26 memory shortage. Ratings are the guide's editorial 1-5 assessments.

laptops.name: MacBook Air 13" M5 (2026)
laptops.pros: Fastest single-core; silent; 12-14 h; best trackpad/speakers/webcam; macOS Unix; 7-yr support; resale
laptops.cons: $200 price hike Jun 2026; 60 Hz IPS; 2 ports (left side); no upgrades; no CUDA
laptops.verdict: The default recommendation. Buy 24 GB.

laptops.name: MacBook Air 15" M5 (2026)
laptops.pros: Bigger screen, six speakers, larger battery, same chip as 13"
laptops.cons: Same as 13"; 270 g heavier
laptops.verdict: Best if the laptop is your primary screen.

laptops.name: MacBook Air 13" M4 (2025) — Certified Refurbished
laptops.pros: ~87% of M5 for 2/3 the price; new battery & shell from Apple; full warranty; 16 GB
laptops.cons: 256 GB base (add external SSD); stock varies daily; 60 Hz
laptops.verdict: The best value laptop in 2026 for a CS student who wants macOS.

laptops.name: MacBook Pro 14" M5 (2025)
laptops.pros: Best laptop display; best speakers; real ports; fan-cooled sustained perf
laptops.cons: $700 over Air w/ same chip; M6 refresh rumored fall 2026 — wait or buy refurb; Wi-Fi 6E
laptops.verdict: Great machine, wrong month. Refurb or wait for M6.

laptops.name: MacBook Pro 14" M5 Pro (2026)
laptops.pros: 1.5-1.65x base M5 multi-core; 307 GB/s; TB5; Wi-Fi 7; three ext displays; ~21 h video
laptops.cons: $300 hike; OLED redesign rumored 2027; no CUDA
laptops.verdict: The professional engineer's Mac. 48 GB is the sweet spot.

laptops.name: MacBook Pro 16" M5 Pro (2026)
laptops.pros: 100 Wh; coolest sustained; best speakers on any laptop
laptops.cons: 2.14 kg; price
laptops.verdict: Desktop replacement. Consider a 14" + monitor instead.

laptops.name: MacBook Pro 14"/16" M5 Max (2026)
laptops.pros: Fastest Apple silicon; 614 GB/s; 128 GB unified runs 70B LLMs locally
laptops.cons: Overkill for software engineering; price
laptops.verdict: Only if you know why (local LLMs, video, research).

laptops.name: MacBook Neo (A18 Pro, 2026)
laptops.pros: Apple build at $599 edu; macOS; fast single-core; silent
laptops.cons: 8 GB with no 16 GB option — struggles with Docker + IDE; one ext display; weaker camera/gamut
laptops.verdict: Great laptop, wrong RAM for CS. Stretch to a refurb M4 Air.

laptops.name: ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 14 Aura Edition (2026)
laptops.pros: Best laptop keyboard; 1.0 kg; Linux-certified; ports; excellent battery on Panther Lake
laptops.cons: List price is fiction — wait for sale; soldered RAM; some display SKUs weak
laptops.verdict: The Mac alternative for people who won't buy a Mac. Never pay list.

laptops.name: ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 13 (Lunar Lake, 2025)
laptops.pros: Superb battery; 32 GB standard on top SKUs; heavily discounted now
laptops.cons: 8-core Lunar Lake is CPU-weaker than Panther Lake
laptops.verdict: The value X1 Carbon in late 2026.

laptops.name: ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 AMD (2026)
laptops.chip: AMD Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450 / AI 9 PRO
laptops.pros: Notebookcheck 'excellent'; up to 64 GB; ThinkPad keyboard; best-in-class Linux
laptops.cons: AMD fan noise on calls; sale-or-nothing pricing
laptops.verdict: The Linux workhorse.

laptops.name: ThinkPad T14 Gen 6 AMD (2025)
laptops.pros: SO-DIMM slot; Ethernet; USB-A; MIL-STD; Linux-certified; cheap ADP
laptops.cons: Base panel mediocre — pick the 400-nit; weak speakers
laptops.verdict: Best port-rich, upgradeable dev laptop near $1,000.

laptops.name: ThinkPad T14 Gen 3/4 AMD (used, 2022-23)
laptops.pros: 32 GB for ~$500; ThinkPad keyboard; perfect Linux; repairable
laptops.cons: Used; battery may need replacing ($60); 720p webcam on some
laptops.verdict: Best laptop-per-dollar for a CS student in 2026.

laptops.name: ThinkPad P14s Gen 7 (Panther Lake + RTX PRO 1000 / AMD)
laptops.chip: Core Ultra 7/9 Series 3 or Ryzen AI 9 PRO 475
laptops.pros: ThinkPad durability + workstation power; AMD variant has SO-DIMM to 96 GB; ISV certs
laptops.cons: Intel+dGPU variant 5-7 h; heavier
laptops.verdict: The serious Linux/Windows workstation that fits a backpack.

laptops.name: Framework Laptop 13 Pro (Panther Lake, 2026)
laptops.pros: 10/10 repairability; 18 h PCMark; 700-nit matte 3:2 panel; official Ubuntu/Fedora; upgrade CPU later
laptops.cons: LPCAMM2 is $800/32 GB in 2026; 4 ports at a time; base 325 chip has small GPU
laptops.verdict: The Linux and longevity pick. 'Right laptop, wrong time' on price.

laptops.name: Framework Laptop 13 (Ryzen AI 300, DIY)
laptops.pros: Cheapest route to 32 GB on a repairable laptop; SO-DIMM
laptops.cons: 8.5 h battery; you assemble it
laptops.verdict: Framework on a budget.

laptops.name: Dell XPS 14 (2026, DA14260)
laptops.pros: Most MacBook-like Windows laptop; +55% battery vs prior; great speakers/webcam; physical F-row is back
laptops.cons: Shallow keyboard; soldered RAM; Dell list — wait for 15-20% sale
laptops.verdict: Premium Windows ultraportable done right, finally.

laptops.name: HP OmniBook Ultra 14 (2026)
laptops.chip: Intel Panther Lake or Snapdragon X2 Elite
laptops.pros: CNET's favorite Windows laptop 2026; X2 version ~11 h real uptime; good keyboard
laptops.cons: HP consumer support; Arm caveats on X2 SKU
laptops.verdict: Excellent Windows all-rounder; choose Intel for x86, X2 for battery.

laptops.name: HP OmniBook 5 14 (Snapdragon X Plus, OLED)
laptops.pros: PCMag battery champion; OLED under $700; fanless-quiet
laptops.cons: Windows on Arm; 2024 chip ~M1-class; 16 GB max
laptops.verdict: Best new Windows laptop under $700 for modern-stack students.

laptops.name: Surface Laptop 8th Edition 13.8" (2026)
laptops.pros: Superb build/keyboard/trackpad; 3:2 120 Hz; 15+ h; Mac-like standby
laptops.cons: Arm caveats; list price — seen at $1,299
laptops.verdict: The Windows MacBook Air. Buy on sale.

laptops.name: Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x Gen 11 (Snapdragon X2 Elite)
laptops.pros: Best X2 laptop overall per thedeskbrief; OLED; light; long battery
laptops.cons: Arm caveats; USB-C only
laptops.verdict: Top Snapdragon X2 pick.

laptops.name: Asus Zenbook S14 (2026, Panther Lake)
laptops.chip: Intel Core Ultra 7 Series 3 (small GPU tile)
laptops.pros: Gorgeous Ceraluminum build; brighter OLED; quiet; long battery
laptops.cons: No Arc B390 in this SKU; shallow keyboard; Asus support
laptops.verdict: Beautiful ultraportable; check the SKU.

laptops.name: Asus Zenbook 14 OLED (2025, Ryzen AI / Lunar Lake)
laptops.pros: OLED + 75 Wh under $1,000
laptops.cons: Shallow keyboard; SKU roulette; Asus support
laptops.verdict: Value OLED ultraportable.

laptops.name: Asus ROG Zephyrus G14 (2026)
laptops.pros: Gaming laptop that passes as an ultrabook; USB-C charging; OLED; runs Unreal/CUDA
laptops.cons: 8 GB VRAM; soldered RAM; hot under load; Asus support
laptops.verdict: The one gaming laptop to bring to class.

laptops.name: Asus ROG Zephyrus G16 (RTX 5070 Ti / 5080)
laptops.pros: 12-16 GB VRAM — the useful floor for local ML; balanced 16"
laptops.cons: Price; battery
laptops.verdict: Best-balanced premium ML/game-dev laptop.

laptops.name: Lenovo Legion Pro 5i / 7i Gen 10
laptops.pros: Full TGP; excellent keyboard; SO-DIMM + dual M.2; 99 Wh; tasteful; CNET pick
laptops.cons: 2.5 kg; loud under load
laptops.verdict: The engineer's gaming laptop.

laptops.name: Lenovo LOQ 15 (RTX 5060)
laptops.pros: Cheapest competent RTX 5060; upgradeable; PC Gamer value pick
laptops.cons: Plastic; 4-5 h; loud; Zen 4 'Ryzen 7 250'
laptops.verdict: Only if you need a GPU on a budget.

laptops.name: Razer Blade 16 (2026)
laptops.pros: PC Gamer #1; the MacBook Pro of gaming laptops
laptops.cons: Price; battery; Razer support
laptops.verdict: Premium dGPU for those funded.

laptops.name: HP ZBook Ultra G1a (Strix Halo)
laptops.pros: 128 GB unified on x86 — the PC answer to M5 Max for local LLMs; no dGPU needed
laptops.cons: Rare; pricey; ROCm/Vulkan not CUDA
laptops.verdict: Unique: big local models on Windows/Linux.

laptops.name: ThinkPad P1 Gen 8 (RTX PRO)
laptops.pros: ThinkPad keyboard + real Nvidia GPU + Linux certification; 24 GB VRAM option
laptops.cons: Price; battery
laptops.verdict: The professional's CUDA laptop.

laptops.name: Framework Laptop 16
laptops.pros: Only laptop with a swappable GPU module; modular keyboard deck; Linux-first
laptops.cons: Thick/heavy for its class; GPU options lag
laptops.verdict: Modularity maximalism.
